description: The camera and movement paradigm. Drives scene composition, sprite proportions, and tilemap layout.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}
And this pacing pick:
{prior_picks.pacing_style}

Generate {count} distinct gameplay style options. Each must be a viable approach for a Playdate game (400x240, 1-bit, 30fps default).
Consider:
- Camera angle: top_down | isometric | side_scroll | first_person | fixed_screen | mode_7 | vertical_scroll
- Movement: grid | free_2d | on_rails | click_to_move | physics
- Scale: room | single_screen | world_map

Each option MUST differ from the others by camera angle.
Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the gameplay option below per the user feedback. Keep it Playdate-appropriate (1-bit, 400x240, 30fps). Adjust camera, movement, scale, sprite/tile size recommendations, or rationale as needed.

option_schema.name: string (e.g. 'Top-down Zelda-like')
option_schema.camera: enum: top_down | isometric | side_scroll | first_person | fixed_screen | mode_7 | vertical_scroll
option_schema.movement: enum: grid | free_2d | on_rails | click_to_move | physics
option_schema.rationale: string — why this fits the style guide
option_schema.references: array of strings — other games using this style
option_schema.preview_prompt: string — the image gen prompt for a mockup of this style
